description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization functions for Certificate Transparency (CT) data structures, including SCT lists, signed entries, tree leaves, and SCT signatures, primarily used in certificate transparency logging.

classes.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp
classes.description: Represents a Signed Certificate Timestamp used in Certificate Transparency.

classes.name: SignedTreeHead
classes.description: Represents the Signed Tree Head in Certificate Transparency logs.

classes.name: MerkleTreeLeaf
classes.description: Represents a leaf node in the Merkle Tree used in CT.

methods.name: ReadSCTList
methods.description: Reads a TLS-encoded list of SCTs into a vector of StringPiece.

methods.name: ConvertHashAlgorithm
methods.description: Converts a numeric hash algorithm identifier to an enum.

methods.name: ConvertSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Converts a numeric signature algorithm identifier to an enum.

methods.name: EncodeAsn1CertSignedEntry
methods.description: Encodes a SignedEntryData of type X.509 certificate.

methods.name: EncodePrecertSignedEntry
methods.description: Encodes a SignedEntryData of type PreCertificate.

methods.name: EncodeDigitallySigned
methods.description: Serializes a DigitallySigned structure into a CBB or string.

methods.name: DecodeDigitallySigned
methods.description: Deserializes a DigitallySigned structure from input.

methods.name: EncodeSignedEntry
methods.description: Encodes a SignedEntryData based on its type.

methods.name: ReadTimeSinceEpoch
methods.description: Reads a timestamp from CBS and converts to base::Time.

methods.name: WriteTimeSinceEpoch
methods.description: Writes a base::Time timestamp into CBB.

methods.name: EncodeTreeLeaf
methods.description: Encodes a MerkleTreeLeaf into a string.

methods.name: EncodeV1SCTSignedData
methods.description: Encodes SCT signed data with timestamp, log entry, and extensions.

methods.name: DecodeSCTList
methods.description: Decodes a string into a list of SCTs.

methods.name: DecodeSignedCertificateTimestamp
methods.description: Decodes a string into a SignedCertificateTimestamp object.

methods.name: EncodeSignedCertificateTimestamp
methods.description: Serializes a SignedCertificateTimestamp into a string.

methods.name: EncodeSCTListForTesting
methods.description: Encodes an SCT list for testing purposes.
